# NxtDuo

> NxtDuo is a small, independent, two-person app studio from India. It builds small, careful products for everyday life: apps, games and tools made for India, with local languages, no dark patterns and no selling of user data.

Contact: support@nxtduo.com
Website: https://nxtduo.com/

## Apps

- [Talk With Swamy](https://nxtduo.com/talk-with-swamy/): A quiet chat on the teachings of Sri Ramana Maharshi. Ask in your own words; it answers in his calm style, using only passages from his recorded words in 10 books, and names the book each answer comes from. Status: Live on the web. The Android and iPhone apps are in store review. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/talk-with-swamy/privacy/
- [NxtDue](https://nxtduo.com/nxtdue/): Vehicle insurance, PUC, passports, subscriptions, warranties: add them once and NxtDue reminds you in time, with notifications that actually arrive. Your data stays in India. No ads, no data selling. Status: In review. The iPhone app is in App Store review; Android is in closed testing on Google Play. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/nxtdue/privacy/
- [Publik](https://nxtduo.com/publik/): A free guide to 1,801 public spaces in Bengaluru: parks, playgrounds, lakes, libraries and public toilets, with timings, directions, "open now" and "near me". Visitors can flag a place that is under repair, anonymously. Status: Live. Free on the web at publik.nxtduo.com. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/publik/privacy/
- [FableFox](https://nxtduo.com/fablefox/): Indian bedtime stories told in a parent's own voice. Read two short lines once, and FableFox tells stories from the Ramayana, the Panchatantra and Tenali Raman in your voice, calling your child by the pet name you use at home. Status: Testing with families. A test version is with a small group of families. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/fablefox/privacy/
- [Meter Mele](https://nxtduo.com/meter-mele/): Drive an auto through streets built from real map data. Pick up passengers and get them there before the meter beats you. Potholes, rain, night rides and leaderboards, in the browser on any phone or laptop. Status: Live · Play free. Free in your browser at meter-mele.pages.dev. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/meter-mele/privacy/
- [NxtBrush](https://nxtduo.com/nxtbrush/): Guided, animated toothbrushing for ages 3 to 80. A mouth map shows the next zone, a timer counts down, a chime says when to move on. It works offline, with any toothbrush. Status: In development. Android first. Not in the stores yet. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/nxtbrush/privacy/
- [Chai Empire](https://nxtduo.com/chai-empire/): A cosy 3D tycoon game. Start as a chaiwala kid with one roadside tapri, brew masala chai, serve customers before their patience runs out, and grow it into a chain of hotels. In English, Hindi and Telugu. Status: Playable prototype. The first stage is playable. Not released yet. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/chai-empire/privacy/
- [Saathi](https://nxtduo.com/saathi/): A journaling companion that runs entirely on your own phone. You write to it like a diary and it replies in a few warm lines, remembers what matters, and never sends your diary to the cloud. Status: In testing. Test builds are running on Android and iPhone. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/saathi/privacy/
- [Thodu](https://nxtduo.com/thodu/): For children who live far from their parents. Thodu would phone your amma and nanna in Telugu, ask what you would ask, and send you a short note on how they really are. Status: Concept. Nothing is built yet. We are talking to families first. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/thodu/privacy/
